title: Geranium and lime linen spray
subtitle: A light, fresh spray for bedding, pillowcases, and towels
excerpt: A light linen spray of geranium and lime essential oils in perfumers' alcohol and distilled water. Misted onto pillowcases, bedding, and towels from 30 cm. Geranium gives a rosy-green floral note; lime a sharp citrus top. The two together are fresh and clean without being heavy. Makes 100 ml. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Linen spray formulation: 15-20% perfumers' alcohol, rest distilled water; no solubiliser needed at this EO concentration. Total EO load 2-3% for a linen spray to avoid staining fabric. Geranium EO (Pelargonium graveolens): major constituents citronellol and geraniol; rosy-green, floral. Lime EO (Citrus aurantifolia or Citrus latifolia) steam-distilled: limonene dominant; citrus, clean. Cold-pressed lime contains furanocoumarins (photosensitisers), use steam-distilled lime EO for a linen spray to avoid phototoxicity risk when used on bedding touching sun-exposed skin. IFRA limit for geranium EO on fabric: safe at 2% in a leave-on (effectively the fabric) category 1 usage.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mature for 24 hours before first use. Shake before each use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months sealed. The lime top note fades fastest (limonene is highly volatile). The geranium note is more persistent. Shake before use.

glossaryTerms.definition: Skin sensitisation triggered by exposure to sunlight after contact with certain plant compounds (furanocoumarins). Cold-pressed citrus peel oils contain them; steam-distilled versions do not. This linen spray uses steam-distilled lime EO to avoid phototoxicity risk on bedding.

content.text: Add the essential oils to the perfumers' alcohol in the spray bottle. Swirl to dissolve.
Add the distilled water. Cap and shake. Leave 24 hours to mature before first use.
Shake before each use. Mist from 30 cm over the bedding or towel. Allow to dry before sleeping on pillowcases.
12 months in a sealed bottle. The lime top note fades after 6 months; the geranium note lasts longer. Keep away from heat.
